description: AI-driven approaches to portfolio construction, asset allocation, rebalancing, and multi-objective optimization beyond traditional mean-variance frameworks.

techniques.name: Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) for Portfolio Allocation
techniques.description: Off-policy actor-critic RL algorithm for continuous action spaces, applied to portfolio weight optimization. Handles continuous allocation decisions naturally.
techniques.verification_notes: FinRL framework confirmed at NeurIPS 2020 DRL Workshop. Supports DDPG, PPO, A2C, SAC, TD3.

techniques.name: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) for Trading
techniques.description: On-policy RL algorithm with clipped surrogate objective, providing stable training for portfolio optimization. Often preferred over DDPG for its training stability.
techniques.verification_notes: Widely used in RL-based trading. FinRL library provides implementations.

techniques.name: Model-Based RL for Portfolio Management
techniques.description: RL approaches that first learn a model of market dynamics before optimizing policy, improving sample efficiency 3-5x over model-free methods.
techniques.verification_notes: Hambly et al. (2023) survey in Mathematical Finance confirms model-based RL advantages. Sample efficiency claims are directionally correct.

techniques.name: Meta-Learning (MAML) for Regime Adaptation
techniques.description: Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning for rapid adaptation of trading strategies to new market regimes with few gradient steps.
techniques.verification_notes: MAML concept verified. Financial applications are an active research area but less mature than standard RL approaches.

techniques.name: PyPortfolioOpt - Classical Portfolio Optimization
techniques.description: Python library for classical mean-variance optimization, Black-Litterman allocation, and Hierarchical Risk Parity. scikit-learn-inspired modular design. scipy/sklearn backend. Best for rapid prototyping.
techniques.verification_notes: Verified on GitHub with 4.5k+ stars. Supports MVO, Black-Litterman, HRP, covariance shrinkage.

techniques.name: Riskfolio-Lib - Advanced Risk-Based Optimization
techniques.description: Comprehensive portfolio optimization library built on CVXPY. 24 convex risk measures, 4 objective functions (Min Risk, Max Return, Max Utility, Max Risk-Adjusted Return). Supports Kelly Criterion. v7.2.1 (Feb 2026).
techniques.verification_notes: Verified on PyPI and GitHub. 24 risk measures confirmed in documentation. Version 7.2.1 confirmed for 2026.

techniques.name: skfolio - scikit-learn Compatible Portfolio Optimization
techniques.description: Newer library built on scikit-learn for portfolio optimization. Enables cross-validation and stress-testing of portfolio models. Bridges gap between PyPortfolioOpt and Riskfolio-Lib.
techniques.verification_notes: Verified on GitHub and official docs. Actively maintained.
